recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: ropelines and crampons threading a corridor past suspended ice high above cloud
spring fog pooling low while sunset stretches toward nine
open-source harbors flickering—repos weighing anchors for quieter docks
job boards humming while somewhere a keyboard goes briefly cold
consent and care braided awkwardly where help meets telemetry

composer-2-fast.concept: You ride three lanes of fog rolling inland; snip glowing condensation beads on the kick-split beat before they dissolve—each lane speeds when wind spikes.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: lane switch + rhythm tap on downbeats/stutter accents
composer-2-fast.touch_control: thumb swipe between lanes; tap beads
composer-2-fast.session_hook: 30s drops sync to escalating Fred-style chops—clean streaks pop chromatic ribbons.
composer-2-fast.escalation: lanes narrow, beads cluster on offbeats, fake-out ghost beads
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: neon mist over dark water, volumetric fog ribbons

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sort mismatched climbing widgets onto correct carabiners while a melt timer crawls—wrong sorts ice over the UI.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: satisfying magnetic snaps and ice crackle when sets clear
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: color-blind duplicates, rotating bin labels, frost obscuring one column
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper cutout gear icons on slate board

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: A dream-pop lighthouse strobes short color chords; replay the sequence while pad swells mask one note each round.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: memory pattern recall with progressive omission
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: tap colored nodes in order; long-press to hear echo
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: each perfect round layers a ghost harmony
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: longer chains, swapped colors mid-sequence, haze vignette
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: pastel bloom + soft grain, Beach House dusk palette

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick debris—petals, ticket stubs, fog droplets—through offshore gusts into a moving compost ring; misses stack as slippery slush.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: physics flick with aim assist decay
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick swipe with hold-to-charge arc preview
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: combos ignite brief thermals that hoover nearby scraps
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: crosswinds rotate, ring shrinks, sticky slush slows flicks
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor smear over SF spring grey-green
